description: Generate a supervisord config fragment that adds the six Phase 8 Pi components to supervisord_sentinel_full.conf: pi_corpus_ingest, pi_quarantine_reviewer, pi_quarantine_promoter, pi_flagged_review_api, pi_harness_runner, pi_scorer. Each entry uses command=python3 /home/workspace/zo_sentinel/{filename}.py with autorestart=true and stdout_logfile. Reads current supervisord file and appends new entries without modifying existing ones.
